text:
john: Quick heads-up — Console is showing deprecation banners for a handful of tenants but their traffic is still being routed to v2. Weird: banner says 'v1 sunset' yet routing shows v2.

maya: Can you paste a sample request and the console event id?

john: Sample event from ui-telemetry:
```
event: deprecation_banner_shown
route: /v1/generate
tenant: tenant-54
banner_version_shown: v1-sunset
routing_target: v2
```
I think the banner renderer is keyed off the tenant's stored preference which we backfilled months ago.

oscar: Ah. We did a one-time backfill that set dep_banner_state = "legacy" for old accounts. The renderer interprets legacy as show v1-sunset. But routing uses live affinity; that's fine. The mismatch is confusing but not harmful.

lina: The problem is QA flagged duplicate quota reports: some tenants show token usage against both v1 and v2 for the same time windows. That will screw up billing previews.

maya: Duplicate attribution often comes from fanout at the ingress (retry + shadow) where our meter emits both shadow and primary. We added a dedupe key in meters, but might not be present for the backfill path.

oscar: Confirmed: shadow requests include header `X-Shade: true` but the backfill job didn't set `X-Dedupe-Key`. So both meters recorded.

john: Proposed fix: patch backfill to include `X-Dedupe-Key: backfill-<job-id>` and run a reconciliation to subtract shadow-attributed tokens for affected windows.

maya: Also UX ask from PM: update banner copy to reflect actual routing state, e.g., "Clients using v2 — you can ignore this banner" if route != banner. We can synthesize that with a small join in renderer — cheap fix.

lina: Reconciliation plan: (1) identify windows where tenant has overlapping v1 & v2 attribution with identical request_ids; (2) run subtract pass against billing-preview table; (3) emit audit rows so we can revert. I'll own step 1.

oscar: Ops note: for step 2 we should rate-limit the reconciliation to avoid spikes on quota windows — do in batches of 100 tenants/hour.

john: QA automated check: qa-bot, can you run the UI smoke to ensure banner copy change won't regress A/B experiments?

qa-bot: queued job: ui-banner-copy-smoke -> results expected in 20m :gear: 

maya: One more telemetry request — surface a new metric in console: "banner_vs_routing_mismatch_rate" per tenant. Make it 1m and 1h aggregations so PMs can correlate with quota deltas.

oscar: I'll add the metric to routing traces and flag it for sampling at 100% for affected tenants for the next 24h.

john: Filing follow-ups: ENG-4567 backfill dedupe patch, ENG-4568 reconciliation runbook, ENG-4569 banner copy join. Thanks all.
